attributes.board_name: Oregon Board of Licensed Social Workers

rules.accepted_credit_types: Conferences, seminars, workshops, books/articles and recorded trainings provided or approved by a credentialing body recognized by the Board; Board-approved individual events (max 10 h per report); agency in-service (up to half); accredited college courses; study groups (up to half); presenting; language courses (max 25%); field-placement supervision (max 6 h/year).
rules.new_licensee_rule: No CE report for the period covered by the initial registration/license; shorter first periods are prorated.
rules.carryover: Excess hours may carry over to the next report, max 10 hours.
rules.audit_note: Routine random audits; keep certificates and program information for at least 24 months after reporting.

topics.who: Must meet Oregon Health Authority standards (ORS 413.450, OAR 943-090-0010)
Suicide risk, assessment, treatment and management

rules.notes: Biennial report with the renewal application, due before the end of the birth month. CE may be attended in person or online. Certified social work associates (CSWA) need no CE.
